purpose: Measure bounded rest-pose geometric clearance and contact relationships between exact sticker assembly parts using actual transformed triangle geometry, with broad-phase bounds, narrow-phase triangle distance, conservative touching/contact language, and closed-surface inside witnesses for grounded penetration claims.

properties.operation: inspect-clearance-contact, measure-sticker-clearance-pair, measure-sticker-assembly-clearances, validate-clearance-plan, or compare-sketch-clearance
properties.database: local UC sticker SQLite registry; relative paths must stay in creations/.axm-build or may be outside the machine body
properties.part_b: second distinct direct assembly child id
properties.pairs: optional bounded explicit list of direct-part id pairs; omitted means bounded all-pairs scan
properties.tolerance_m: optional finite geometric tolerance in metres

contains: broad-phase AABB lower-bound and overlap evidence
triangle-level minimum surface distance and closest point witnesses
SEPARATED, TOUCHING, PENETRATING, CONTACT_OR_INTERSECTION, or UNMEASURED relation
closed-surface inside witness before any PENETRATING claim
exact-sketch-bound minimum-clearance, contact, and no-penetration requirement results

relationships: uses the same actual rigid GLB geometry truth boundary as Sticker Geometry Calipers
flattens nested assemblies and multiplied wrappers through exact stored transforms
keeps clearance requirements in an exact sketch-bound companion plan instead of silently rewriting the established Design Workshop sketch schema
reserves PENETRATING for a positive inside witness and holds unresolved zero-distance intersections instead of guessing

implementation.source: src/axm_uc/sticker_clearance_contact.py via src/axm_uc/__init__.py registration; matching JSON operations are also exposed through src/axm_uc/sticker_create.py

limitations: v0.1 measures authored/default rest pose only and does not sweep animation
supported geometry is the same bounded rigid embedded GLB TRIANGLES subset used by current sticker calipers
closed-surface point classification checks welded topology but does not itself prove freedom from self-intersection; ambiguous classification holds
CONTACT_OR_INTERSECTION means zero-distance evidence exists but touching versus penetration is not grounded strongly enough
clearance/contact evidence does not prove physics, strength, manufacturability, gameplay behavior, aesthetics, engine acceptance, or runtime performance
v0.1 reports penetration witness but not penetration depth or automatic geometry repair

truth.basis: Distance comes from actual triangle geometry; AABB overlap is never promoted to contact, and penetration requires a positive inside witness.

agency.basis: Humans, scripts, and machine callers choose exact assemblies, pairs, tolerances, sketches, and companion requirements; measurement does not silently rewrite assets.

continuity.basis: Reports bind exact immutable assembly/sketch/plan state and preserve nested exact source pins rather than replacing definitions.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Work is bounded; unsupported/open/ambiguous geometry holds instead of inventing a contact or penetration verdict.
